prerequisites: The App and OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel are running with the observe profile, which exposes policy.probe.

steps.instruction: Have External Consumer call policy.probe for a representative write capability and its bounded fixture arguments.

expected_results: The policy decision denies the target capability without invoking its provider.

evidence_requirements.description: Gateway request identifier returned to External Consumer.
Matching audited policy.probe request and denied target decision.
Digest of the independently captured External Consumer result.

cleanup_steps: Confirm that no workspace content changed.

prerequisites: The operate profile is active, at least one generic execution or process-control capability is not granted, and policy.probe is exposed.

steps.instruction: Have External Consumer call policy.probe for an ungranted generic execution or process-control capability such as process.cancel.

expected_results: The policy decision is a deterministic denial and no subprocess or process-control action starts.

evidence_requirements.description: Matching audited policy.probe request and denied target decision.

cleanup_steps: Verify no child process remains.

prerequisites: The App Control Plane is running and a disposable schema-1 manifest is available.

steps.instruction: Use the embedded CLI to validate a manifest that binds a remote caller or remote transport to local-admin.

expected_results: Validation rejects the manifest before any remote transport starts and records the denied control request.
cleanup_steps: Delete the disposable invalid manifest; the active configuration remains unchanged.

prerequisites: Two separately authorized workspaces exist.

steps.instruction: Use one workspace authorization to target the other workspace.

expected_results: The cross-workspace operation is denied and neither workspace changes.

evidence_requirements.description: Tunnel instance used by the external call.
Independent digest proving both workspaces are unchanged.

cleanup_steps: Remove only fixtures created for this case.

prerequisites: A bounded fixture workspace is authorized.

steps.instruction: Submit a path containing parent-directory traversal outside the workspace.

expected_results: Path resolution is rejected before filesystem mutation.
cleanup_steps: Delete the bounded fixture workspace.

prerequisites: A fixture symlink points outside the authorized workspace.

steps.instruction: Request a write through the escaping symlink.

expected_results: Resolved-path containment blocks the operation.
cleanup_steps: Remove the fixture symlink and workspace.

prerequisites: A reviewed operation ticket can be issued for a fixture mutation.

steps.instruction: Use one ticket successfully, then replay the same ticket.

expected_results: The first call succeeds and replay is rejected.

evidence_requirements.description: Issue, consume, and replay request identifiers.
Independent proof that mutation occurred once.

cleanup_steps: Remove the fixture mutation.

prerequisites: A deterministic hanging fixture provider is configured.

steps.instruction: Have External Consumer call the hanging fixture with the reviewed timeout.

expected_results: The call terminates within the bounded timeout and the provider is recoverable.
cleanup_steps: Stop the fixture provider.

prerequisites: A cancellable deterministic fixture call is available.

steps.instruction: Start the fixture call and cancel it from the external consumer.

expected_results: Cancellation reaches the provider and leaves no child process.
cleanup_steps: Stop the fixture provider and remove markers.

prerequisites: The deterministic downstream MCP fixture is reviewed and running.

steps.instruction: Crash the downstream fixture, then call its reviewed catalog again through External Consumer.

expected_results: The provider reconnects and its reviewed surface returns.

evidence_requirements.description: Provider exit and reconnect audit events.

cleanup_steps: Stop the downstream fixture and remove its marker files.

prerequisites: The downstream fixture can advertise an unreviewed tool after startup.

steps.instruction: Enable tool-list drift and attempt to call the new tool through External Consumer.

expected_results: The unreviewed tool is not exposed and direct invocation is denied.
cleanup_steps: Reset and stop the downstream fixture.

prerequisites: External Consumer Connector and Secure MCP Tunnel are healthy.

steps.instruction: Restart only the App gateway, wait for bridge recovery, then call a read tool from External Consumer.

expected_results: The Connector works again without recreating the tunnel profile.

evidence_requirements.description: Tunnel instance before and after gateway restart.

cleanup_steps: Leave the intended App and tunnel desired state running.

prerequisites: The Connector is attached to the maintained test chat and the App catalog has a reviewed change.

steps.instruction: Refresh the actual External Consumer Connector, verify the reviewed catalog change, and call its designated read-only sentinel tool.

expected_results: External Consumer discovers exactly the allowed App catalog and the sentinel call is correlated to the refreshed surface.

evidence_requirements.description: External Consumer request for the reviewed sentinel tool.
Independent digest of the External Consumer-visible catalog and sentinel result.

cleanup_steps: Restore the intended Connector profile if it was changed.

prerequisites: The current App permission state is recorded locally without changing user-owned TCC settings.

steps.instruction: Have External Consumer call computer.permissions and then a bounded Computer Use operation governed by the reported permission state.

expected_results: A granted permission permits the bounded operation; a denied permission returns the documented deterministic error; neither path requests TCC remotely.

evidence_requirements.description: Permission-state and bounded Computer Use requests.
Independent External Consumer result or deterministic error digest.

cleanup_steps: Leave user-owned TCC settings unchanged.

prerequisites: Codex App Server, Exec, and MCP providers are separately configured.

steps.instruction: Attempt to override reviewed Codex authority or lifecycle fields from an External Consumer call.

expected_results: The override is rejected and no provider lifecycle is crossed.
cleanup_steps: Restore only disposable Codex fixture state.

prerequisites: A deterministic sentinel secret is stored only in a disposable Keychain item.

steps.instruction: Exercise OpenAI and Cloudflare calls that reference the sentinel, then inspect bounded logs and audits.

expected_results: No token or sentinel value appears in logs, audits, results, or exported configuration.
cleanup_steps: Delete the disposable Keychain sentinel and fixture output.

prerequisites: A fixture skill contains folded YAML frontmatter.

steps.instruction: Discover and read the skill through External Consumer, then compare it with local provider parsing.

expected_results: External and local skill metadata are identical and bounded.
cleanup_steps: Remove the fixture skill.

prerequisites: The active App catalog, deterministic fixtures, OpenAI Connector, and named Cloudflare endpoint are healthy.

steps.instruction: Generate the live catalog and invoke every applicable tool from an external consumer on its allowed transport.

expected_results: Every live tool has an external call, one matching local execution record, and an independently verified result.

evidence_requirements.description: Exact transport for each catalog row.
Exact local audit for each request.
Independent result or postcondition digest for each row.

cleanup_steps: Run fixture cleanup and preserve only sanitized summary plus hashes.

prerequisites: The actual External Consumer Connector is configured for the maintained Secure MCP Tunnel profile.

steps.instruction: From the maintained External Consumer page, discover resources/prompts/tools and perform representative read, write, provider, Codex, Process, and Computer Use calls.

expected_results: External Consumer is the external MCP consumer for every call and the complete path is correlated locally.

evidence_requirements.description: Actual External Consumer call request identifiers.
Independent Computer Use observations and result digests.

cleanup_steps: Remove disposable fixtures only; external Connector cleanup remains user-owned.

prerequisites: A remotely managed named tunnel, public hostname, gateway bearer, and optional Access policy are configured.
cloudflared 2025.4.0 or newer is installed because token-file is required.

steps.instruction: Start the App-owned loopback origin and named cloudflared lifecycle, then call discovery and a bounded mutation from an external MCP client.

expected_results: The named tunnel is healthy, bearer enforcement is active, and its capabilities cannot cross into an OpenAI profile.

evidence_requirements.description: Unauthorized probe plus authenticated MCP calls.
Independent external MCP client result digest.

cleanup_steps: Stop the named tunnel and remove only its temporary 0600 token file.

prerequisites: A disposable Validation development environment is used; no release profile or secret is involved.

steps.instruction: Run the explicitly development-only Quick Tunnel probe and confirm it is never persisted as desired state.

expected_results: The probe is labeled development-only and cannot enable noauth or a release profile.

evidence_requirements.description: Independent proof that no desired state or token remained.

cleanup_steps: Terminate cloudflared and delete all ephemeral URL, log, token, and PID files.

prerequisites: A clean ad-hoc App bundle or release DMG is available.

steps.instruction: Install the App, install the embedded CLI link into ~/.local/bin, and confirm both operate the same App control plane.

expected_results: The symlink is owner-controlled, PATH diagnostics are actionable, and CLI/App state is identical.

evidence_requirements.description: CLI status and bounded tool request identifiers.
Independent bundle, CLI, link, and state digest.

cleanup_steps: Uninstall only the test symlink and test App copy.

prerequisites: The final App and DMG were produced from one native SwiftPM build.

steps.instruction: Verify version, signing identity, embedded CLI hash, DMG installation, launch, control socket, and public-file scans.

expected_results: App, CLI, and DMG metadata and hashes agree; no personal path, credential, generated evidence, or oversized source artifact is present.
cleanup_steps: Remove staging and mounted DMG state; retain only final dist artifacts.
